summary.name: Google AI
summary.one_liner: Google AI is Google's hub page showcasing its AI products (such as Gemini and Nano Banana) through example creative, learning, productivity and experimental prompts.
use_cases: Generate images and video from prompts
Turn a PDF into an animated visual
Create music soundtracks from a description
Retouch a selfie into a studio-style profile photo
Build small custom tools or apps without coding
Get real-time help via Search Live
summary.what_it_does: The page is a landing hub for Google AI that lists example prompts for creative, knowledge, productivity, student and experimental uses of Google's AI products. The examples cover image and video editing, turning PDFs into animated web apps, generating playable games, 3D-printable designs, soundtracks, and headshot retouching. It names Gemini, Gemini Omni, Nano Banana, Search Live in the Google app, and Gemini Notebook. Most entries are demo prompts rather than documented features, and the page gives no pricing or technical specifications.
notable: Hub that links to Gemini, Gemini Omni, Nano Banana and other Google AI products
Example prompts span image, video, music, 3D design and game creation
Includes experimental products and a Search Live feature in the Google app
caveats: Page is mostly promotional example prompts; few concrete feature specs or pricing are given
Some items are marked COMING SOON and may not be available yet
